caption: The drawing shows six rectangular swatches arranged in two horizontal rows of three on a plain, off-white background. Each swatch displays a different repetitive geometric or organic pattern and uses combinations of black, brown, red, and beige colors. The top left swatch shows a brown and beige pattern of overlapping semicircular shapes filled with small circular designs. The top middle swatch has a grid of black starbursts with small red dots at their centers on a grayish background. The top right swatch features vertical scallop shapes with alternating red and beige stripes, decorated with small black and white circular motifs. The bottom left swatch consists of an orange-brown background with a black diamond and star-like geometric pattern. The bottom middle swatch displays a swirling pattern of black and red curving lines and dots on a beige background. The bottom right swatch is similar in form to the top left but has a background of brownish-red and beige scalloped shapes decorated with tiny black and white motifs. The rectangles are evenly spaced and occupy the central part of the paper.
title: Swatches
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
